similar_in_english: Every mouth tells a different tale
example_sentences_in_bangla: গাঁয়ে একটা ঘটনা ঘটলে দশমুখে দশকথা ছড়িয়ে পড়ে।
সবাই নিজের মতো করে বলে, তাই দশমুখে দশকথা হয়ে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: When an incident happens in the village, rumors spread with ten mouths and ten words.
Everyone has their own version, so it turns into ten mouths and ten words.
history: The idiom draws from the mythological figure Ravana, the ten-headed demon king from the Ramayana epic, symbolizing how multiple mouths lead to multiple conflicting narratives.
note: References Hindu mythology, emphasizing the chaos of varied perspectives in folklore.
